article.name: What is Etsy Plus?
article.title: What is Etsy Plus?
article.body:
Ready to take your shop to the next level? Etsy Plus is a subscription package of advanced seller tools and services that can help you manage and grow your shop.

To sign up for Etsy Plus:

  1. On Etsy.com, go to Shop Manager.
  2. Select Settings.
  3. Select Your subscription.
  4. Select Upgrade under Etsy Plus.
  5. Select Confirm.

The fee for an Etsy Plus subscription is $10 USD per month, which you'll see deducted from your payment account balance.

Learn more in our Fees & Payments policy. 

Unsubscribe from Etsy Plus

You can cancel your Etsy Plus subscription anytime by going to Your subscription in Shop Manager. You will have access to your Etsy Plus subscription until the end of that subscription cycle, and your final day of access will be identified in the Your Subscription dashboard. 

After your Etsy Plus subscription has ended, your shop will return to Etsy Standard, and you will no longer have a subscription fee added to your payment account.

Enjoy free listings and Etsy Ads credits

When you sign up for Etsy Plus, you'll get the following monthly credits:

  • 15 credits for creating or renewing listings
  • $5 USD in Etsy Ads credit, which are visible on your Etsy Ads page

Credits don’t roll over month-to-month and will expire if they’re not used. Credits are reset and replenished at the beginning of each monthly subscription cycle.

Learn how to run an Etsy Ads campaign. 

Let shoppers know when the items they love are restocked

When you enable restock requests, shoppers can sign up to receive alerts when your sold-out items are back in stock. 

Learn more about restock requests.

Give your shop a custom look

As an Etsy Plus subscriber, you have access to an expanded set of customization tools, such as:

  • Multiple banner options
  • Layout options for featuring listings
  • The ability to feature specific listings or shop sections
  • Custom color theme for your Shop Home

Learn more about advanced shop customization.

Unlock unlimited Marketplace Insights searches

Marketplace Insights provides sellers with direct access to real Etsy search data. As an Etsy Plus subscriber, you’re able to search for unlimited keywords to find out how buyers are searching on Etsy, dig into the competitive landscape, and discover similar keywords to help optimize your shop.

Learn more about Marketplace Insights.
